setup.name: Your name
conflict.title: Updated by another user
conflict.body: Someone saved this record after you opened it. Reload to see their version; what you typed is kept below so you can apply it again.
home.title: Your engagements
home.adminNote: Platform administrator — you can see every project.
home.programNote: You have access to a program and every project in it.
home.emptyAdmin: No projects yet. Create a client and a project under Administration.
home.emptyUser: You have not been given access to a project yet. Ask a project owner or a platform administrator.
project.dashboardBody: Plan vs actual and BR/FR status per workstream arrive with the build slices. The business function chart and requirements come first (slice 1).
program.subtitle: Program view — each project keeps its own data.
program.rollupSoon: Roll-up figures arrive with the build slices.
section.processes.title: Business process flow
section.processes.what: Process flow editor, JSON import, and step inputs and outputs.
section.dfd.title: Data flow diagram
section.dfd.what: Generated from the same steps and data entities as the process flow.
section.requirements.title: Business requirements
section.requirements.what: The function chart, one requirement per process, and CRUD on data entities.
section.brfr.title: BR–FR map
section.interfaces.title: Interface list
section.data.title: Data entities
section.data.what: Logical data entities and fields; the ERD follows in slice 2.
access.title: Who can open this project
access.subtitle: Everyone with access, including people who arrive through the program and platform administrators.
access.userIdHelp: Ask a platform administrator for the person's user id.
access.oneScope: Each person holds access to one project or one program. Someone who already has access elsewhere has to be moved by a platform administrator.
access.count: {n} people · revoking is recorded in the audit log and cannot be undone — grant again instead.
access.revokeBody: {name} will lose access to this project on their next click. Revoking cannot be undone — to give access back, grant it again.
admin.title: Administration
admin.subtitle: Platform administrators only. Creating a project grants nobody access — give access from the project's Access screen.
admin.name: Name
admin.deactivateBody: {name} will be signed out on their next click and cannot sign in again. Their history stays.
admin.adminBodyGrant: {name} will see every client's projects. Give the reason — it is kept in the audit log.
admin.adminBodyRemove: {name} will lose access to every project they do not hold a grant for. Give the reason — it is kept in the audit log.
